body:
I decided to give this an attempt of my own. I used an herbal vaporizer, half of one tea bag of sleepytime tea which is primarily chamomile and other ingredients [Chamomile, spearmint, lemongrass, tilia flowers, blackberry leaves, orange blossoms, hawthorn and rosebuds.].
The results are:
Harsh on lungs, I found it best to let it roll off the tongue first, then hold it in for about 10 seconds and exhale. After smoking the amount I packed in (half the bag) my eyes feel dryer and I feel a little more relaxed, I am somewhat tired. Can't say that this is anti anxiety treatment, I guess I can relate it to drinking maybe 2-3 bags worth, it made me tired and a little relaxed. This did not bring me to a state of euphoria as others have written, I wasn't tripping.
